title: Escape From Tarkraft
description: Modern weapons. Tactical gear. A high-stakes multiplayer extraction shooter inside Minecraft.
body: # **Escape From Tarkraft** ![Tarkraft Hero](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1819/457/money-png.png) _A realistic multiplayer extraction shooter experience._ *** ## 🔥 **Features** **Multiplayer** – Fully networked with anti-cheat (US West). ![Back Mall](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1829/745/scope-png.png) **Native Shaders** ![Shadows](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1890/919/shadows-png.png) **Quests & Tasks** – Progression that keeps you grinding. **Custom Items & Mechanics** – Unique systems never before seen in Minecraft. ![Module](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1829/762/gpu1-png.png) **Ballistic Realism** – * Armor penetration by bullet type * Colored smokes * Persisting bullet entities ![Hideout](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1829/763/atdeskvignette-png.png) **Armor Plates** – Modular protection mechanics. **Backpacks** – Bring more loot to the battlefield. **Dynamic Maps** – Shatter glass with gunfire. **Tactical AI** – * Long- and close-range tactics * Melee-rushing bosses * ⚠️ Beware the **Factory Boss**… *** ## 🚧 **In Development** 🚧 *** ## 🌐 **Community & Support** * 💬 Join the [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/7KVa7nMUbP) * 💎 Support us at [**CraftingStore**](https://escapefromtarkraft.craftingstore.net/) * Cosmetic hideout [**Upgrades**](https://escapefromtarkraft.craftingstore.net/) *** ## 🛠️ **About This Helper Mod** This **client-side mod** is required for ShiftingKill’s **Escape From Tarkraft server**. It adds: * Modular **gun part rendering** * **Dynamic lighting & fog effects** * **Keybinds & QoL features** * Much more… *** ## 🎨 Assets & Attribution Some gun models in Escape From Tarkraft are provided by the **[maxstuff pack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/maxstuff)** by Max (maxinablender). All assets are used **with permission** under the **CC 4.0** license. _Not all models from the pack are included; only selected assets are used in this mod. Future updates may include more attachments as I can add them. You may not use any of the models from this pack unless permitted by the original model makers. We are actively commissioning new weapon assets that fit post-apoc Russian style games. If you want to contribute, please send a message._ Special thanks to the creators and contributors of Vic's Modern Warfare \[Discontinued\] / Modern Warfare Cubed for sound assets used under the Apache License 2.0. Not all sounds are used and we are working on replacing all of them. Tarkraft is built on the work of many creators in the Minecraft modding community. Thank you for making projects like this possible. See the `CREDITS.txt` file included with the mod for full attribution and license information.

gallery.title: Map: Interchange
gallery.description: A huge map and server built by just one developer with the help of model makers.

gallery.title: Upgrade Modules
gallery.description: Upgrade your hideout to sustain life. Enhance player stats, store loot, and test out weapons in the shooting range.

gallery.title: Medical Station
gallery.description: Every limb has a custom hitbox. Status effects like bleeding, heavy bleeding, fracture must be taken care of with specialized medical items. Limbs at 0 HP distribute damage taken to other limbs.

gallery.title: Extract
gallery.description: Find the extraction zone to safely transport you out of raid zones. Different spawns have different extraction points.

gallery.title: The Hideout
gallery.description: An abandoned bomb shelter you use as your headquarters to prepare for raid. Upgrade modules to make it home.

gallery.title: Native Shadows
gallery.description: No need to install separate mods

gallery.title: Map: Shoreline
gallery.description: Includes a 1:1 resort and extensive loot. The radio tower and weather station are visible in the distance. Scavengers and bears roam this land
